---
- name: Configure node1 as DHCP server on the private network
  hosts: vyos_router

        set service dhcp-server shared-network-name LAN authoritative
        set service dhcp-server shared-network-name LAN subnet 10.50.50.0/{{ private_cidr }} subnet-parameters "option routers {{ router_ip }};"
        set service dhcp-server shared-network-name LAN subnet 10.50.50.0/{{ private_cidr }} range LAN_POOL start {{ pool_start }}
        set service dhcp-server shared-network-name LAN subnet 10.50.50.0/{{ private_cidr }} range LAN_POOL stop {{ pool_stop }}
        set service dhcp-server shared-network-name LAN subnet 10.50.50.0/{{ private_cidr }} default-router {{ router_ip }}
        set service dhcp-server shared-network-name LAN subnet 10.50.50.0/{{ private_cidr }} name-server 1.1.1.1
        set service dhcp-server shared-network-name LAN subnet 10.50.50.0/{{ private_cidr }} lease 3600
        commit
        save
        exit
        '
      register: vyos_config_result
      changed_when: "'No changes' not in vyos_config_result.stdout"

    - name: Show applied VyOS config result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        var: vyos_config_result.stdout_lines

- name: Configure DHCP clients to obtain address on the private network

  gather_facts: true

      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "/etc/systemd/network/60-{{ private_iface }}-dhcp.network"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          [Match]
          Name={{ private_iface }}

          [Network]
          DHCP=yes

          [DHCP]
          UseDNS=false
          UseRoutes=true

    - name: Renew DHCP lease on the private interface
      ansible.builtin.command: "networkctl renew {{ private_iface }}"
      changed_when: true

    - name: Wait for the private interface to obtain an address

      changed_when: false

    - name: Report obtained address

      register: iface_addr
      changed_when: false

    - name: Show obtained address
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        var: iface_addr.stdout_lines
ANSIBLE_EOF
